comparison.objective: Triangulate a buried corner iron from witness tapes and stand a stake on it; candidate commissions a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Tape interpretation, hidden-location inference, and stake placement versus tool engagement, counterholding, collar rotation, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Stake released upright on the recovered iron; localization tolerance and stability duration are absent. Candidate requires two quantified non-bottoming stops and post-lock retention.
comparison.reason: Survey localization and placement exercise a different tested ability from mechanical damping adjustment and dynamic verification.
